sources.observation: The kauri facade resembles pale masonry. A shallow columned porch and wide steps sit in the center of the four-storey frontage. Ground-floor windows are arched, upper floors rectangular.

limitations: The photographed exterior sets the sash spacing, ornate cornices and porch details. Small roof features and individual ornamental profiles are estimated.
